title: agent: continue long-running command shouldn't trigger "AgentStuckInLoop" Error
body:
**What problem or use case are you trying to solve?**

The agent can continue a long-running command by sending an empty command "" in a `CmdRunAction`. However, when it is doing it three times in a role, the agent controller will flag it as agent-stuck-in-loop and stop the whole conversation.

**Describe the UX or technical implementation you have in mind**

We should:
1. The continue bash command shouldn't trigger a stuck in a loop error (e.g., add an exception in stuck in loop detection for empty command that resumes previous command)
2. (1) is probably a bad solution since it adds a new special case --- A better way would be, we should update the prompt here (https://github.com/All-Hands-AI/OpenHands/blob/e40681ca61fb2b4b602fe916d99def6b55b78d77/openhands/runtime/utils/bash.py#L550-L557) to tell the agent the previous command timed out AND the agent should try use the `timeout` argument in the `execute_bash` tool to run this command for longer time.

We should probably try (2) first, if it didn't solve the problem; Then we should try (1).

**Additional context**


### If you find this feature request or enhancement useful, make sure to add a 👍 to the issue

linked_prs.title: runtime(bash): clarify guidance when previous command still running; recommend execute_bash timeout (issue #10350)

diff --git a/openhands/runtime/utils/bash.py b/openhands/runtime/utils/bash.py
index c5eea320d78b..8afd5a1add3e 100644
--- a/openhands/runtime/utils/bash.py
+++ b/openhands/runtime/utils/bash.py
@@ -554,11 +554,9 @@ def execute(self, action: CmdRunAction) -> CmdOutputObservation | ErrorObservati
             metadata = CmdOutputMetadata()  # No metadata available
             metadata.suffix = (
                 f'\n[Your command "{command}" is NOT executed. '
-                f'The previous command is still running - You CANNOT send new commands until the previous command is completed. '
+                'The previous command is still running - You CANNOT send new commands until the previous command is completed. '
                 'By setting `is_input` to `true`, you can interact with the current process: '
-                "You may wait longer to see additional output of the previous command by sending empty command '', "
-                'send other commands to interact with the current process, '
-                'or send keys ("C-c", "C-z", "C-d") to interrupt/kill the previous command before sending your new command.]'
+                f'{TIMEOUT_MESSAGE_TEMPLATE}]'
             )
             logger.debug(f'PREVIOUS COMMAND OUTPUT: {raw_command_output}')
             command_output = self._get_command_output(
